summary.headline: Judgment on Acquiring a Kingdom
summary.text: Astrological judgment of whether a querent will obtain a kingdom, using the ascendant, midheaven, their lords, the Moon, reception, conjunction, opposition, and square aspects to assess success, delay, difficulty, and whether the kingdom comes voluntarily.
